sources.citation: Blench, Roger. 2025. The classification of the Bukwen language [buz] spoken in Mairogo, SE Nigeria. Circulation draft. Cambridge: Kay Williamson Educational Foundation. 9 pp. (Glottolog ref 700825; listed by Glottolog as a comparative study;wordlist). Full 9-page text is embedded in the academia.edu page (id 128924135), archived copy (Internet Archive, 21 Aug 2026) and extracted to txt.

sources.note: Nothing. Sections are Introduction, 'The controversial question of West Beboid', Analysis, Appendix (Table 1: c. 79-item Bukwen wordlist retyped from Koops 1971, tone-marked, with Mashi and external cognates; Table 2: Bu/Koshin/Mundabli). Tokens stress/accent/tone = 0/0/0. States 'The Bukwen language is known only from a short wordlist, collected by Robert Koops in Mairogo, SE Nigeria, in 1971.'
